plainLanguage: Fort Worth uses the 2021 International Residential Code with local changes, but still uses the older 2015 energy code. Every new house needs a foundation designed and stamped by a Texas engineer because of the area's shifting clay soils. In the common A-5 zone your lot must be at least 5,000 sq ft and 50 ft wide. Keep the house 20 ft back from the front, 5 ft from the sides and rear, and 10 ft from a side street on a corner. The house can be up to 35 ft tall and cover up to half the lot. The city cannot require brick or stone, but your HOA or deed restrictions might. Budget about $5,800 for water and sewer impact fees plus a transportation impact fee that depends on where you build.
